iran_nuclear.name: IRAN NUCLEAR
iran_nuclear.notes: IAEA pressure rises again: Reuters reports Grossi urging Iran to re-engage while a U.S.-backed Board of Governors resolution demands answers on damaged sites and enriched uranium stocks. AP says inspectors still lack access to bombed facilities and cannot verify enrichment activity or stockpile disposition.

iran_conventional.name: IRAN WAR / GULF
iran_conventional.notes: Gulf war risk remains near maximum. Reuters video and live reporting say U.S. forces struck Iranian coastal surveillance sites after drones moved toward the Strait of Hormuz; prior Reuters reporting still describes the Strait as largely closed with oil routes constrained and talks strained.

israel_lebanon.name: ISRAEL-LEBANON
israel_lebanon.notes: Lebanon channel exists but remains brittle. Al Jazeera marks 100 days of Israel’s latest Lebanon war and says fighting continues in the south despite direct talks and multiple failed implementation efforts; earlier ceasefire announcement has not fully controlled events.

turkey.name: TURKEY REGIONAL
turkey.notes: Turkey remains indirectly exposed to Iran-war spillover and air-defense posture. Search results were dominated by March missile-intercept background and social posts; no fresh Turkish direct clash, new weapons trial, or major cross-border operation crossed threshold.

india.name: INDIA-PAKISTAN
india.notes: India-Pakistan remains elevated but below acute threshold. Reuters/Al Jazeera report deadly protests in Pakistan-administered Kashmir, including 11 killed, but this is internal unrest rather than verified cross-border India-Pakistan military exchange.

russia.name: RUSSIA-NATO
russia.notes: Russia-NATO spillover remains imminent after prior Romanian drone fallout and UK diplomatic response. Fresh search did not add a new Article 5-level incident, but eastern-flank airspace risk and strategic rhetoric remain active.

china.name: CHINA-TAIWAN
china.notes: China-Taiwan moves back to critical. Reuters reports Taiwan ran a coastal rapid-response drill simulating destruction of an invading force, while Reuters/CBS-linked reporting says China launched live-fire drills around Taiwan simulating a port blockade and disrupting flight planning.

north_korea.name: NORTH KOREA
north_korea.notes: DPRK rises on a fresh reported ballistic projectile launch: DW cites South Korea saying North Korea launched a ballistic missile on June 9. Reuters background still shows late-May enhanced ballistic and cruise projectile activity; no atomic device event confirmed.

russia_ukraine.name: RUSSIA-UKRAINE
russia_ukraine.notes: Russia-Ukraine remains at maximum. Reuters reports Russian-run Zaporizhzhia officials accused Ukraine of drone attacks near the plant on June 4, while earlier IAEA/Reuters reporting showed drone damage to plant monitoring equipment; strategic-risk floor remains extreme.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: PAKISTAN-AFGHANISTAN
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: Pakistan-Afghanistan remains critical but edges lower. Fresh search was dominated by Wikipedia/background and February-April Reuters items on border fighting and China-mediated talks, not a new June cross-border strike. Carry-forward border-war posture remains the only active signal.

sudan.name: SUDAN CIVIL WAR
sudan.notes: Sudan remains critical on baseline civil-war spillover and humanitarian risk; not part of this 10-zone scan and no fresh activation was assessed in this run.

israel_palestine.name: ISRAEL-PALESTINE
israel_palestine.notes: Gaza/Israel-Palestine remains imminent from carry-forward strike and negotiation risk; not part of this 10-zone scan.

south_sudan_abyei.name: SOUTH SUDAN / ABYEI
south_sudan_abyei.notes: South Sudan/Abyei remains elevated; not part of this 10-zone scan.
